html:
Let’s go with Vietlook travel to review the top delicious dishes in Ha Long. Let’s refer to them before having the opportunity to travel to Ha Long so that when you arrive, you will not be surprised and choose the menu that you love the most.

It can be said that Ha Long not only brings visitors clear blue beaches, or admire the natural wonders of the world, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious dishes with fresh seafood.

Banh cuon cha muc

Ha Long squid is very fresh and delicious, bought by locals as soon as the boat docks, so it is very fresh and delicious, processed and eaten with hot banh cuon, mixed with dipping sauce to bring a delicious flavor unique to the sea.

Cu ky is a very fresh and attractive type of sea crab, with firm and delicious meat, eaten with vermicelli is a nutritious dish chosen by many diners when traveling to Ha Long, in addition, Cu ky vermicelli is also eaten with seafood such as: mantis shrimp, sea shrimp, sea worms, squid… with the sweet taste of the broth mixed with seafood to bring a delicious flavor that diners will remember forever.

Chao Sa Sung

This is a very good and nutritious sea ginseng, if you have the opportunity to go on a tour to Ha Long, you must definitely try this dish, to feel the delicious taste of the sea and islands.

Ngan Bien

This is one of the foods rich in nutrients, and is a very rare dish in Quang Ninh, Ha Long, so when you have the opportunity to set foot here, visitors must definitely enjoy this delicious and nutritious dish.

Ha Long Pearl Yogurt

Yogurt combined with fragrant coconut milk blends together to bring diners a cool taste, a dish that cannot be missed during the summer days in Ha Long, enjoying it while admiring the poetic scenery of the sea and islands is nothing more interesting.

Sea Sam

A nutritious dish of the Ha Long sea, and one of the rare seafood, is processed by chefs into many different delicious dishes such as: grilled sea sam cartilage, stir-fried sea sam with vermicelli, …

White sticky rice with squid cake

Squid in Ha Long is very delicious, enjoying it with white sticky rice is nothing more interesting, a popular dish but chosen by many diners when coming to Ha Long.

Tien Yen hill chicken

This is a type of chicken that is free-range, and is processed into many dishes with delicious flavors that attract many diners when coming to Ha Long to choose this delicious dish.

Nodding cake

is a type of cake without filling, eaten with a special dipping sauce of the sea, making diners nod in approval, even the most difficult customers.

Tien Yen Sardine

It is a very attractive dish, the Sardine meat is firm and chewy, can be fried or boiled and then eaten with hot rice or bread, for Tien Yen people, Sardine can be processed into a dipping sauce, a famous specialty of Tien Yen people.
